stress_transport: Use GEANT development/validation-selected filters unchanged on GEANT-stress.
common_quality_gate: Retain the original 20-batch, loss, sample-age and delivered-delay requirements for every new filter.
persistence_snapshot: For each of the last k complete generation batches, reconstruct the received prefix at that batch's last receipt plus 1 ns; use only reports generated no later than that batch. Recompute the same proposer on that prefix. All k choices must equal the current candidate and all margins must exceed m.
no_eligible_candidate: No parameter is selected. Report failure; do not manufacture a test operating point.
frontier_scope: Descriptive test sweep; existing validation-selected ICTC threshold is unchanged.
family: Within each topology and endpoint, Holm adjustment across all selected new-filter contrasts against proposer and ICTC; confidence intervals remain nominal.
headroom: Ratio of population mean utility gains; bootstrap complete paired seed blocks jointly. A zero denominator is undefined, never zero-imputed.
claim_scope: New post-review offline comparisons on retained populations, not a new untouched confirmation. No existing controller, threshold, fitted model or simulation record is changed.
